item.title: Dozens of emaciated horses seized from Ocala non-profit, owners ordered to pay over $90K
item.description: The owners of an Ocala horse rescue and sanctuary have been ordered by a local judge to pay over $90,000 to the Marion County Sheriff’s Office for costs associated with the care of over 70 emaciated horses that were seized in November.
